title: Monthly planning
description: Work with the planning copilot from discovery through a reviewable month of drafts.
startDescription: Choose a month to collect decisions, context, and a proposal in one persistent workspace.
sessionsDescription: Your saved monthly decisions and proposal history.
sessionDescription: Discovery, strategy, execution, and review stay together so the final drafts are explainable.
copilotDescription: Ask questions, record decisions, and generate a typed proposal only when the context is ready.
firstPrompt: Start by describing what matters most this month. The copilot will ask for missing decisions instead of guessing.
placeholder: Share a priority, constraint, offer, event, or question…
proposalDescription: Review objectives, assumptions, risks, and draft rows before anything is created.
brandKitDiffDescription: These are suggestions only. They are not applied with draft rows and require a separate manager approval.
requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Try again.
stale: This proposal is out of date because its source context changed. Regenerate it before applying.
